chunks: From him, from his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: Ten feedings do not prohibit anything.
ai.seo_question: How many feedings are required to establish mahramiyyah in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the Shia juristic consensus that ten distinct feedings (radha'at) are necessary to establish permanent kinship (mahramiyyah), distinguishing it from the Hanafi view of a single feeding. It underscores the precision required in fiqh al-radha', where the count refers to separate occasions rather than total volume, ensuring clarity in marital prohibitions. This ruling is foundational for understanding family law dynamics in Shia Islam, particularly regarding inheritance and marriage eligibility.
